key_idea: Count all the frogs, then share them so both ponds have the same number.
steps: The left pond has 10 frogs. The right pond has 4.
Half of 14 is 7, so each pond needs 7 frogs.
The left pond must go from 10 down to 7. 10 - 7 = 3 frogs hop.

choice_feedback.A: After 1 frog hops, the left pond has 9 and the right pond has 5. That is not the same.
choice_feedback.B: After 2 frogs hop, the left pond has 8 and the right pond has 6. That is not the same.
choice_feedback.C: After 4 frogs hop, the left pond has 6 and the right pond has 8. That is not the same.
choice_feedback.E: After 6 frogs hop, the left pond has 4 and the right pond has 10. That is not the same.
